book.name: 3 Yon
book.title: 3 Yon Yeoa Koldumbvm Nomoa Kristusnindmoa, Himba Temba Numhowol Vivrava Moanonoanamba.

content: Kava Yon, Kristusnindna kuwul, yemba kavna seh Gaiusm, yemba kava und vev honindava, pivva memba mongawundna ahamnavpa moanonoamba, temba pimba Kristusnindva doarava hillinamba.
Seh, kava nonora lohv, yenamba undva beswonam lohv. Kava sembayang vev, osm manimani yeindava phovra besalangas, wo eva yemba uvavulva venavramoa.
Monglava Kristusnindva ambnamba homba kaindamba, ishumnina kamba, ona, Gaiusva moanonoamba doa wohkek vethanamba, temura wohengv. Wo honinda kava mindnamba indk vethana.
Kava osva hellellohvpa, kava kavpa ambo eisil wohalohv, noinda kavna otovotalmsna wohengiv keknam moanonoamba.
Seh, temba besal, nomba wevsava, yimba temba kolvrowol velohvpa Kristusnindmba. Yimba eva kolvrowol vev hindm Kristusnindm, nom yimba hemba tit vewol vev.

Noi ten kaindam ambnam, he eishunvna Kristusnindmba huiva, sna und vewolalmba, yimba temba wulluhvpa. Kava yemba nengmanav, osm yeoa dioa osangas wohkolvrowol vilango hemoa monaraoa, nonamba himba hengava lovahmana velmba vevrava. Kolvrowol vilangavm hemoa no monana, osva Sesoava noindava si eva wohindlothovrata.
Manara, himba doa ten wohambv monam, Kristusm andra venalm. Himba dumbunvramoa mana vemava henonamba, himba temba mendahva puehallava avpa.
Wo noinda osva pioa hemoa kolvrowol velvohra monaraoa. Wo nonamba nomba pivva vivrava, pivva osva anilhamana vevra moanonoana andranindilm hemongo.
Kava novol vinna tombaiva yena Kristusnindm, wo heva os Diotrepesva hellevmoa honamba. Himba undva vrev, osmangas kangas mongal kuwulva wulluhv.

Noinda nonam kav provram yeindam, kava si ishunvav yemba, osva ora, os vewol vev Diotrepesva. Himba dasalm ishunv moakoklana pimba. Wo heva os nongasva himba vevmoa, himba owai vev, kolvrowol velmba, nomba temba wulvahmana vevpa moanonoamba. Wo osoa hev vev, olwolv hindm owalm Kristusnindm, nom ten he kolvrowolalm vivm nom Kristusnindm, temba moanonoamba wulvahmana vevpa, wo olwolv sembayangmba.

Seh, yimba manam daohtpot vivav mana vemakoklarava, daohtpot vivm nom besalmangas. Himba nomba vetava nomba besalva, temba Sesoanamini. Wo heva os himba nomba sahoklalva vevrava, himba wohtit vrev mendah Sesoamba.

Indkumbiva Demitriusmba wivuleiv. Wo eva moanonoava Sesoanamba osta hemba wivuleivta. Manara, Demetriusva wohenglohv no moamba. Eva kava ishumniv hemba beswonam, wo yimba nonora lohv, nomba osva temba kava eishovpa, tanamolnam.
Kava iav esvema moamba, yemba ishomnalmba, heva os kava eunumbovavmoa penna inknamba kavnamba.
Kava nengv, yemba lelnam nonglakalmba. Wo di pivva mongawulm ihishovav.
Undwonam ao. Sehpevpa memba kava wonavpa, piambmanav yemba hevna und velva. Yeoa vrahunu kana und vewolaloa indakonda sehmoa dioa. Doata.
